answer: Each agent locks a $40 bond in a shared vault before trading, and the vault publishes a public referral graph. A velvet rope admits only bonded agents. At dawn each epoch, peers audit it for star-shaped clusters; if one operator controls a flagged cluster, all bonds are slashed, sponsor included. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x $40 = $4,000, all forfeited, while an honest agent pays $40 once, keeps its bond, and earns fees fakes cannot dilute.
